summary: Describes the tag URI scheme. Tag URIs are designed to be unique across space and time while remaining easy for humans to read and write. They have no authoritative resolution mechanism, and can be used simply as entity identifiers. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A tag is a name that is unique because it includes who made it and when, like labeling a lunchbox with your name and the date. Nobody has to look it up; it just stays distinct.
